<h3 id="使用net内置的smtpclient类">使用.NET内置的SmtpClient类</h3>
<p>在.NET中，可以通过System.Net.Mail命名空间下的SmtpClient类发送邮件。需要配置SMTP服务器地址、端口、凭据等信息。</p>
<h3 id="具体实现可参考netcorekevin的kevinemail模块">具体实现可参考NetCoreKevin的Kevin.Email模块</h3>
<p>基于.NET构建的企业级SaaS智能应用架构，采用前后端分离设计，具备以下核心特性：<br>
前端技术：</p>
<ul>
<li>Vue3前端框架</li>
<li>IDS4单点登录系统</li>
<li>一库多租户解决方案</li>
<li>多级缓存机制</li>
<li>CAP事件集成</li>
<li>SignalR实时通信</li>
<li>领域驱动设计</li>
<li>AI智能体框架</li>
<li>RabbitMQ消息队列</li>
<li>项目地址：github：<a href="https://github.com/junkai-li/NetCoreKevin" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/junkai-li/NetCoreKevin</a><br>
Gitee: <a href="https://gitee.com/netkevin-li/NetCoreKevin" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/netkevin-li/NetCoreKevin</a></li>
</ul>
<p>EmailService实现</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using Kevin.Email.dto;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Mail;
using System.Net.Mime;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Kevin.Email
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 邮件服务
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public class EmailService : IEmailService, IDisposable
    {
        private readonly EmailSetting _emailSetting;

        private readonly SmtpClient _smtpClient;
        public EmailService(IOptionsMonitor&lt;EmailSetting&gt; config)
        {
            _emailSetting = config.CurrentValue;
            _smtpClient = new(_emailSetting.SmtpServer, _emailSetting.Port);
            _smtpClient.Credentials = new NetworkCredential(_emailSetting.AccountName, _emailSetting.AccountPassword);
            _smtpClient.EnableSsl = true;
            _smtpClient.UseDefaultCredentials = false;
            _smtpClient.DeliveryMethod = SmtpDeliveryMethod.Network;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            _smtpClient.Dispose();
        }

        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 发送邮件
        /// &lt;/summary&gt;
        /// &lt;param name="email"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
        /// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
        /// &lt;exception cref="NotImplementedException"&gt;&lt;/exception&gt;
        public async Task&lt;bool&gt; SendEmail(SendEmailDto email)
        {  
            using (MailMessage message = new())
            {
                foreach (var filePath in email.FileList)
                {
                    Attachment data = new(filePath.Key, MediaTypeNames.Application.Octet)
                    {
                        Name = filePath.Value
                    };
                    message.Attachments.Add(data);
                }
                message.From = new(_emailSetting.AccountName, email.FromDisplayName);
                foreach (var toAddress in email.ToAddresses)
                {
                    message.To.Add(new MailAddress(toAddress));
                }
                message.Subject = email.Subject;
                message.Body = email.Body;
                message.BodyEncoding = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8;
                message.IsBodyHtml = email.IsBodyHtml;
                await _smtpClient.SendMailAsync(message);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}

</code></pre>
<pre><code>var smtpClient = new SmtpClient("smtp.example.com")
{
    Port = 587,
    Credentials = new NetworkCredential("username", "password"),
    EnableSsl = true,
};

var mailMessage = new MailMessage
{
    From = new MailAddress("from@example.com"),
    Subject = "Subject",
    Body = "&lt;h1&gt;Hello&lt;/h1&gt;",
    IsBodyHtml = true,
};
mailMessage.To.Add("to@example.com");

smtpClient.Send(mailMessage);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="使用mailkit库">使用MailKit库</h3>
<p>MailKit是一个更现代、功能更强大的邮件处理库，支持更多协议和高级功能。</p>
<pre><code>var message = new MimeMessage();
message.From.Add(new MailboxAddress("Sender Name", "from@example.com"));
message.To.Add(new MailboxAddress("Recipient Name", "to@example.com"));
message.Subject = "Subject";

var builder = new BodyBuilder();
builder.HtmlBody = "&lt;h1&gt;Hello&lt;/h1&gt;";

message.Body = builder.ToMessageBody();

using var client = new SmtpClient();
client.Connect("smtp.example.com", 587, SecureSocketOptions.StartTls);
client.Authenticate("username", "password");
client.Send(message);
client.Disconnect(true);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置依赖注入">配置依赖注入</h3>
<p>在ASP.NET Core中，可以通过依赖注入方式配置邮件服务。</p>
<pre><code>services.AddTransient&lt;IEmailSender, EmailSender&gt;();
services.Configure&lt;EmailSettings&gt;(Configuration.GetSection("EmailSettings"));
</code></pre>
<p>实现EmailSender类：</p>
<pre><code>public class EmailSender : IEmailSender
{
    private readonly EmailSettings _emailSettings;

    public EmailSender(IOptions&lt;EmailSettings&gt; emailSettings)
    {
        _emailSettings = emailSettings.Value;
    }

    public async Task SendEmailAsync(string email, string subject, string message)
    {
        // 使用MailKit或SmtpClient实现发送逻辑
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="使用fluentemail库">使用FluentEmail库</h3>
<p>FluentEmail提供了流畅的API来构建和发送邮件。</p>
<pre><code>var email = Email
    .From("from@example.com")
    .To("to@example.com")
    .Subject("Subject")
    .Body("Hello");

email.Send();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="处理异步发送">处理异步发送</h3>
<p>对于Web应用，建议使用异步方式发送邮件以避免阻塞请求线程。</p>
<pre><code>public async Task SendEmailAsync(string to, string subject, string body)
{
    using var smtpClient = new SmtpClient("smtp.example.com");
    var mailMessage = new MailMessage("from@example.com", to, subject, body);
    await smtpClient.SendMailAsync(mailMessage);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置邮件模板">配置邮件模板</h3>
<p>使用Razor模板引擎生成邮件内容，保持视图和逻辑分离。</p>
<pre><code>var template = "Hello @Model.Name, welcome to our service!";
var result = Razor.Parse(template, new { Name = "John" });
</code></pre>
